overview_exclusion.criterion: Maximum absolute zero/twice-fill sensitivity across both model states and all 159 times; mask if above 1% of the fixed display span. Same mask in every overview. This is not a bound on unknown source flux.

processing.source: Calibrated SCI surface brightness in MJy/sr, with ERR/WHT quality checks. Negative values retained until display.
processing.convolution: Float64, full linear FFT convolution of pixel-area averaged intensity; native 768x768 unit-flux 1.65 um PSF with tilt retained, no recentering or size multiplier.
processing.boundary: Both fields have real source context covering the entire kernel; no external-sky extrapolation.
processing.missing: Nearest-valid fill where SCI/ERR are nonfinite or WHT is nonpositive/nonfinite. Wide field can include such points. Detail includes none directly. Zero and twice nominal fill sensitivity is measured for every frame; it is not a bound on unknown saturated flux.
processing.band: F164N 1.645 um, bandwidth 0.020 um approximated by archived monochromatic 1.65 um PSF. No band integration, colour composite or continuum subtraction.
processing.source_psf: Observed JWST PSF, mosaic resampling, diffraction spikes and noise retained; no deconvolution. Effective image response includes both JWST and model PSFs.
processing.field: One on-axis PSF over the selected 59.17 x 47.77 arcsec field; no anisoplanatism or real instrument footprint prediction.
processing.display: Fixed asinh 30–400 MJy/sr, softening 15 MJy/sr, magma pseudocolour after linear convolution; lower and upper tails clipped for display only. Native axes, vertical flip; pupil alignment is assumed.
processing.time: 159 archived image times, 1500 original point-source Strehl samples; no interpolation, exposure integration, new AO trajectory or extra detector noise.

exclusion.criterion: Maximum absolute zero/twice-fill sensitivity across both model states and all 159 times; mask if above 1% of the fixed display span. Same mask in every overview. This is not a bound on unknown source flux.
